Commentary.Commentary: What now for Australia? The confidence will be down for them but they need to try and replicate what South Africa did. Stay tuned for the Protean reply.

Philander and Abbott wrecked havoc in "English-like" conditions with 5 and 3 wickets respectively as the Aussie batting line-up showed its inability to play disciplined and quality swing and seam bowling. Add to the fact that Dale Steyn is not even playing. Just two batsmen managed to reach double figures with the skipper scoring more than half the runs. For people looking for something positive out of this rubble, only one Australian batsman scored a duck.

It has taken South Africa just 7.5 overs after Lunch to dismantle Australia. Steven Smith maintained a strange decision of not hogging the strike as he kept exposing the tail and the Proteas got through. An exceptional bowling performance from South Africa. Sorry, I correct myself. ANOTHER exceptional bowling performance from South Africa.

OUT! de Kock's catch sums up Australia's innings! Fuller outside off, Lyon goes for the drive from his crease. He gets an outside edge that flies towards Hashim Amla at first slip. de Kock though flies to his right and takes a stunner in front of Amla who falls down having being blinded by the keeper. Had de Kock dropped it people would have asked him if he needed to go for it but that is what sums up Australia's innings today, nothing has gone their way. Absolutely nothing. Vernon Philander has taken five wickets here, his tenth five-wicket haul in Tests. AUSTRALIA HAVE BEEN SKITTLED OUT FOR 85!
Good length outside off, Lyon defends this one well.

Bowls it on middle, comes in, Lyon is hit on his back pad. The bowler does not even bother appealing and keeps running and celebrating as if it was always out. The umpire says no. Philander cannot believe it, South Africa do not have any review left. Replays show the ball would have kissed the bails. Marginal call.
Good length on off, comes in, Lyon covers the line and gets it off the outer half towards gully.
Good length outside off, Lyon punches it back to the bowler.
On a length on off, Lyon plays it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat for a single. Not sure Australia know what they are doing here.

Outside off on a good length, Smith punches it through covers. They take the couple easily but Smith is late to go for the third and he just runs. Maharaj returns the throw from sweeper cover at the non-striker's end. Abbott then throws at the keeper's end but Lyon has to dive to get back into his crease.
FOUR! On a length outside off, Smith gets across and gives it an almighty heave. He gets it through mid-wicket. Philander ambles after it from mid on but was always going to lose the race there.
Angled on a length on middle, Lyon gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Nathan Lyon is the last man in.

OUT! Catching practice to Amla! Bowls it on middle, Hazlewood stays in his crease and pokes at it. The ball goes off the edge and carries nicely to Hashim Amla who dives to his right at first slip and takes a good catch. The procession continues for Australia, the early singles are not working for Smith too. He needs to shield the tail and not expose them.

Angled on a length outside off, Smith looks to punch it through but gets it off the inner half back towards the bowler. Abbott is a bit lazy to stop the ball. Smith spots it and takes a single as the fielder from mid off comes in to stop the single.
FOUR! Top shot, Josh! Fuller outside off, Hazlewood this time presses forward and drives it through mid off. The timing is good and he gets another boundary.
Back of a length outside off, comes in with the angle, Hazlewood is opened up a touch but he does well to defend it towards covers.
FOUR! Take that, Philander! A touch short and wide from Philander, Josh likes the width and he crashes it past point for a boundary. The ball speeds to the fence.
Good length outside off, Hazlewood punches it towards mid off where Rabada dives and does not allow a single.
Fuller outside off, Smith goes for the cover drive but gets it through backward square leg for a single off the inside edge. Does he need to take these singles early in the over?
On a length outside off, Smith lets it go through.
Good length outside off, Hazlewood punches it towards covers off his crease to end another successful over for South Africa.
Bowls it outside off, Hazlewood is happy to let it go through.
Josh Hazlewood walks in. Can he hang around enough and give support to Smith?

OUT! JP, YOU BEAUTY! Abott bowls it outside off on a length, Starc goes for another expansive drive. This time though he only gets an edge that flies quickly towards gully. Duminy dives low to his right and plucks it inches off the ground. He takes off in celebration, Abbott turns around in disbelief, Starc has to go. South Africa continue to annihilate Australia here.
FOUR! How good is that? Outside off on a length, Starc just stands there and pushes it into the gap. The timing is too good and he gets a boundary.
Pitched up outside off, Starc drives it towards covers.

Fuller in length on off and middle, Smith punches it down the ground to the right of the umpire. Bavuma gives it a chase from mid off, fumbles a touch  as he slides to stop the ball and that allows them the third. Bavuma was not happy as he lost the covering on his little finger on his right hand.
Fuller outside off, Starc looks to drive on the up but is beaten.
Good length outside off, Starc pushes it towards point off his crease.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Starc looks to clip but is hit on his body. Mild appeal turned down.
Mitchell Starc comes in to bat.

OUT! BEAUTY! Hurls it on a length on off, this one comes in, Mennie plays for the outswinger keeping in mind the previous ball and that causes the gap between the bat and the pad. The ball sneaks through the gap and Mennis is bowled. End of an impressive little knock from Mennie. He is anyway the only other guy to be in double figures after Smith till now.
BEATEN! Bowls it outside off, goes away a touch, Mennie is beaten as he plays at it from his crease.
Good length on off, Smith gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single. South Africa will not mind it, they get to bowl at Mennie early in the over.
Bowls it on a fuller length on off, Mennie comes forward and defends it.
Bavuma is under the helmet at silly point.
Fuller on off, goes away a touch, Mennie covers the line and defends it.

NOT OUT! Good call, umpire! Angled in on a fuller length outside off, comes in a touch, Mennie is hit on his front pad. The players appeal long and hard but the umpire says not out. Faf again goes for the review. The replays confirm that there was no bat there. The Ball Tracker though shows that it was going over the top of the stumps so South Africa lose both their reviews.
Review time again! Kyle Abbott reckons he has Mennie trapped in front here. He has convinced his skipper to have it reviewed.
Angled in on a length, goes away a touch, Mennie comes forward and keeps it out.
On a length outside off, left alone by Mennie.
Good length outside off, left alone by Mennie.
Gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good length on off, Smith defends it from his crease.

Short and wide outside off, Smith cuts it to Bavuma who misfields. Wait, no, you are reading it right, Bavuma was at fault there. The ball actually spun a touch and hence the misfield occurred. A couple taken.
FOUR! Top shot! Good length outside off, Smith rides the bounce and punches it through covers for a majestic boundary.
Smith gets in line and defends it.
Bowls it down the leg side on a length, Smith lets it go through. Vernon is not quite happy with his delivery there.
Vernon Philander to bowl from the other end. Let's see how he goes here. He can bowl directly and does not have to wait for enough time since it was an external injury.
On a length on off, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Australia!
Fuller outside off, Smith looks to play it straight but gets it through the outer half through covers for a couple of runs.
Angled in on a length on off, Smith clips it towards mid on.

FOUR! Good shot, Smith! Fuller outside off, Smith punches his drive down the ground towards the long off fence. The fielder gives a chase as the ball slows down due to the wet outfield. The ball though has enough to cross the ropes.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, left alone.
Landed on off, comes in, Smith defends it with an inside edge onto his pads.
The players are out in the middle. Steven Smith and Joe Mennie to bat out for Australia. Kyle Abbott to bowl. Good news for South Africa, VERNON PHILANDER IS BACK ON THE FIELD!
Day 1... Session 2...

So, South Africa wouldn't have asked for a better start than this, how long will they take to clean the Aussies up? Will Steven Smith lead from the front and take the score to a respectable one? Let's see how the second session pans out. Join us back at 0740 IST for all the action.

Once that happened, Australia never really got time to recover as the wickets started to tumble and the home side was jolted in the very first hour of play. Khawaja, Voges and debutant Ferguson didn't last long and it only added to their woes. Steven Smith is still out there although he survived an LBW scare earlier but has held one end up. Joe Mennie is partnering him and has hit two confidence-inducing boundaries. The home side would want him to give support to the skipper otherwise, South Africa will run through the tail in a jiffy.

This session - 25 overs, 43 runs and half a dozen wickets! What a sensational session for the Proteas. They got everything going their way, right from the toss apart from an injury to their pacer, Vernon Philander. The overcast conditions helped their cause as Philander and Abbott struck in their very first overs, sending both the Aussie openers back in the hut.
Bowls the yorker on off, Mennie just about brings his bat down in time to get it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. That ends a superb session for the visitors. It's LUNCH, DAY 1!
This is again wide on a fuller length outside off, left alone by Mennie.
Bowls it outside off, asking Mennie to go after it but the batsman is more than happy to let it go.
Shorter length on off, Mennie lets it go over him.
Good length outside off, Mennie comes forward and defends it.
Bouncer! Banged in short on off, Mennie lets it go over him.
Floated outside off, asking Smith to reach out, gets him to do so bt no harm odne.
Another one on middle, Smith defends it back.
Bowls it on off, Smith pushes it back down the wicket.
Full on off, Smith keeps it out from his crease.
Fuller on middle, Smith hits it hard but to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Smith lets it come and defends it.
Angled on the pads, Mennie looks to clip it but is hit on his pads.
FOUR! Too good for a no. 8! Fuller outside off, Mennie watches it closely and drives it hard through covers for a boundary. That was a superb shot!
Angled on a fuller length on off, Smith is opened up a touch but gets a leading edge towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Smith gets across and defends it back.
Bowls it outside off, comes in a touch, Smith looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length outside off, Smith gets across and lets it go through.
Floated on off, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Smith defends it back.
Bowls this fuller on off, Smith prods forward and keeps it out.
Fuller on middle, Smith drives it towards mid off coming forward.
Flatter on middle and leg, Smith works it towards square leg.
Too full outside off, Mennie brings his bat down in time to keep it out.
Good length on off, pushed towards covers by Mennie.
On a length outside off, Mennie defends it back.
FOUR! That's a good shot! Fuller in length on off, Mennie gets in line and drives it down the ground for a boundary. He gets off the mark in style.
Fuller outside off, Mennie plays inside the line and is beaten.
Joe Mennie is the new man in.

OUT! Good review from South Africa! Hurls it on a length outside off, comes in, Nevill looks to defend but is hit on his pads. The players go up for an lbw but the umpire stays put. The players come together and Faf wants the review. The replays show that there was no bat there. Ball Tracker shows that it was hitting the stumps and three reds means the decision has to be overturned and the review works along with the bowling change for South Africa. Australia are in tatters here!
A loud shout for LBW against Nevill is not given by the umpire. Faf du Plessis opts for the review. Is there an inside edge? Is it going down leg? Let's wait and find out...
Kagiso Rabada back on for a bowl.
Floated on middle, Smith drives it nicely but cannot get it past the bowler who dives to his left and stops the ball.
On middle, Smith drives it hard towards mid on who stops it in time.
Shorter one again on off, punched back to the bowler by Smith.
Bowls it too full on off, Smith prods forward and defends it.
A touch short on middle, Smith goes back and works it towards short leg.
Floated on middle, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Nevill.
Bowls it on middle, Nevill clips it towards Bavuma at short leg who is hit on his leg.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Outside off on a length, Nevill comes forward and defends it with an inside edge past short leg. Nevill wants the single but is sent back by Smith.
Fuller outside off, Nevill comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Nevill comes forward and lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Nevill goes back and works it towards third man for a single.
Stays back and defends it from his crease.
Nevill comes down, takes it on the full and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, spins away, Nevill looks to drive and is beaten all ends up.
A touch short on off, goes away a touch, Nevill stays back and defends it. Hint of spin there.
Floated on middle, Nevill comes forward and defends it.
Time for some spin! Keshav Maharaj comes on for a bowl. A slip and plenty of guys saving a single inside the circle.
Fuller outside off, pitches and goes away a touch, Smith lets it go through.
Good length outside off, no shot offered.
Bowls it outside off, on a fuller length, Smith gets across and defends it and screams 'no run' with a visible press.
On a length on off, Smith comes across and clips it towards square leg.
FOUR! LOVELY STROKE! Fuller outside off, Smith comes forward and drives it nicely on the up through covers. The ball races away to the fence.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Smith.
Back of a length outside off, Nevill rides the bounce and keeps it down.
Good length outside off, Nevill presses forward a touch and defends it towards short leg.
Back of a length on off, Nevill gets in line and defends it.
Outside off on a fuller length, Nevill defends it from his crease.
Good shot! Fuller outside off, Smith comes forward and drives it through covers. Dane Vilas runs after it  from mid off and saves a run for his side.

Angled on middle and leg, Smith gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. Maharaj gives it a chase and keeps them to a couple. That is a poor piece of running. There was some hesitation for the third.
Angled on a fuller length on off, Nevill gets in line and defends it.
Good length outside off, comes in long way, Nevill raises his bat and lets it go through.
Works it through the leg side for a single.
Outside off on a fuller length, Smith comes forward and defends it with his bat
Angles it on middle, Smith clips it through mid-wicket.
Pushes this one towards point off his crease.
Nevill gets in line and defends this one again.
On middle and leg, Smith looks to clip it with a shuffle but is hit on his pads. They cross for a leg bye.
Clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Good length on off, Nevill defends it back.
Nevill gets in line and defends it.
Pushes this one towards mid on.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Nevill clips it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Peter Nevill is the new man in.

OUT! AUSTRALIA ARE ON THE MAT! Bowls it outside off, Ferguson defends it towards point. There is a slight misfield by Dane Vilas, the substitute as the ball goes in the deep. He himself goes towards third man fires in the throw and scores a direct hit at the striker's end as Ferguson dives to get into his crease. The fielders are confident it is referred upstairs. The replays confirm the same and Callum's worst fears come true as he is caught short of the crease. He has to go back and Australia are 5 down for 17!
It's a direct hit at the striker's end and debutant Ferguson is the man in question. South Africans are confident and this could be curtains for Ferguson.
Good length outside off, no shot offered.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, left alone.
Philander is going off the field, clutching his right shoulder. Abbott to complete his over.

NOT OUT!  APPEAL, COLLISON, REVIEW! Bowls it on off, comes in, Smith shuffles as he does and looks to clip it through. The ball thuds onto the pads and the players go up in an appeal. Drama ensues as Smith collides into Philander who has his back on him with arms raised in an appeal. Philander falls over. In all of that, Faf du Plessis goes for the review and the Ball Tracker shows it is going over the stumps. Now for the bowler, Philander is having some medical attention. He was hit by Smith's left elbow and is down in serious pain. Faf did inquire with Smith if he was not running in the same line.

A loud appeal for LBW against Smith is taken upstairs but the on-field umpire says not out. Meanwhile, Philander and Smith collide and the former is down in some real pain. Not a good sign for the Proteas. He is the man who has done all the damage...
On a length outside off, Smith defends it back down the wicket.

And another one from Rabada that is angling on the pads, Ferguson clips it through mid-wicket. Abbott comes across from square leg and slides to stop the ball but does well to keep the ball in play. Ferguson is off the mark in Test cricket.
Like finding rain in a desert! This one is misdirected for a change. Slanted on middle and leg, Smith gets across and clips it to square leg for a single.
Angled on a length outside off, Smith defends it off his crease.
Fuller outside off, Smith presses forward and keeps it out.
Fuller around off, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Smith.
No respite for Australia, Kagiso Rabada is introduced into the attack.
EDGED! Outside off on a length, Ferguson plays at it with an open face and gets it to gully who stops the ball in time. End of another good over from Philander.
This one goes away after pitching, Ferguson lets it go through safely.
Outside off, comes in a touch, Ferguson defends it.
OHHH! Bowls it outside off, comes in a long way, Ferguson lets it go on the length and only hears ohhs and ahhs as the ball flies inches over the stumps. Wonderful piece of bowling!

Slants it on a length but down the leg side, Ferguson looks to clip but seems to have missed it. de Kock though collects and throws the ball up in the air to suggest there was some bat there but replays confirm there was none.
Bowls it outside off, Ferguson lets it go through.
Smith wants a change of gloves. He is not happy that no one was watching him at the first instance.
Bowls it a touch fuller outside off, comes in, Smith defends it back.
Bowls from wide of the crease, outside off, on a length, Smith shuffles and defends it back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, left alone.
FOUR! STREAKY! Fuller outside off, Smith goes for the on-drive but gets it off the edge through point. Bavuma gives it a chase, slides near the ropes but cannot keep the ball in play.
Bowls it outside off, swings away, Smith is happy to let it go through.
Fuller outside off, Smith drives it towards mid off.
Hurls it on a length on off, Ferguson is beaten by the movement into him and is hit on his thigh pad.
Misses out on a hat-trick! Bowls it nicely on off, Ferguson comes forward and keeps it out.
In walks Callum Ferguson to face the hat-trick ball. Four slips in place! What a moment this for Callum!

OUT! VOGES GOES FOR A GOLDEN DUCK! Bowls it in the area outside off, Voges has to play at it. The ball was coming in with the angle but pitches and moves away ever so slightly. The ball flies through nicely to the keeper who takes the catch and celebrates. The third umpire checks for the no ball but Philander is okay there. South Africa are all over Australia here.
Adam Voges comes out to bat.

OUT! KHAWAJA FALLS! Hurls it on a good length on middle, Khawaja has to play at it but he only manages to edge it to Hashim Amla at first slip. The wickets continues to tumble for Australia here. Khawaja has to walk back disappointed and Philander continues to be amongst the wickets.
On a length on off, Khawaja is opened up a touch but he does well to defend it.
Fuller but this one is down the leg side, Khawaja looks to clip it through but fails to connect.
Full again outside off, Smith drives it towards covers but not quite in convincing fashion.
Fuller outside off, Smith comes forward and defends it and screams 'no run'.
Good length outside off, Smith stays back and punches it towards covers.
Outside off on a length, Smith keeps it out in time.
Nicely done! Bowls it outside off, Khawaja defends it with soft hands. The ball runs behind point. Maharaj gives it a chase and keeps it them to three.
Khawaja lets this one go through safely.
Temba Bavuma comes in at short leg.
Bowls it outside off, Smith is again opened up and gets it towards gully off his thigh pad. Tough times these!
Outside off, on a length, left alone by Smith.
Oooh! Bowls it on off, goes away after pitching, Smith is into his shuffle and is opened up a touch. The ball goes off the thigh pad towards gully. Nice shape for Philander there!
Good length outside off, Smith rocks back and defends it well.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Smith covers the line and defends it.
It is going to be that kind of a day. The players are back out in the middle. Steven Smith to take strike against Vernon Philander.

0530 IST - Smith is eager to get off the field. Even before the umpires come together as it starts to drizzle. That was expected, the rain delay. Smith is already in the dressing room while Khawaja is trudging along. South Africa have got a superb start and will be eager to get back on the field to play. Shouldn't be long before we are back.
On a length outside off, Smith shuffles across and keeps it out despite getting opened up a touch.
Hurls it outside off, on a fuller length, left alone by Khawaja.
Bavuma at point is asking for the helmet and the gear, he should be in at short leg next over.
Fuller outside off, left alone.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Khawaja is not sure whether to get forward or go back, ends up playing at it and gets an inside edge which falls where a short leg would have been.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja hangs his bat for it. The ball goes off the outer half towards point where Bavuma dives and stops the ball.
Good length on off, Smith gets across again and clips it through backward square for a run.
Fuller outside off, Smith comes across and defends it with soft hands towards gully.
Slips this one down the leg side, Khawaja cannot clip that one.
Landed on off, holds its line, Khawaja defends it away from his body and gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Sprays it a touch wide outside off, Khawaja is not bothered about it.
On a length outside off, Khawaja covers the stumps and lets it go through. That too was a good leave.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Khajawa is tempted to play at it but withdraws his bat late and lets it go.
BRAVE LEAVE! Bowls it outside off, shapes in a touch, Khawaja leaves it on the length but the ball almost shaves the off stump. Can call it a good leave? Maybe but a brave  leave for sure.
Bowls it a touch short outside off, Smith goes across to defend but does so off the inner half of the bat.
On a length on middle, Khawaja looks to clip but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Khawaja comes forward and defends it.
On the pads, Khawaja tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Pitched up outside off, Khawaja plays at it from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on middle, Smith is early into his shuffle and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
A touch fuller on off, comes in, Khawaja covers the line well at the end and keeps it out.
Bowls it outside off, this time Khawaja lets it go.
Edged! In the area outside off, Khawaja has to play at it but does well to keep the edge down with soft hands towards gully.
Outside off, on a length, Khawaja raises his bat to let it go.
Slips this one down the leg side, Khawaja fails to clip it through.
Bowls it outside off on a length, left alone.
STEVEN SMITH walks in to bat. His side is under serious pressure.

OUT! Abbott strikes! Hurls it outside off, comes in, Burns is rapped on his pads as he is late to bring his bat down. The players appeal for an lbw and the umpire raises his finger. There were a couple of noises but does Burns review? Nope. He walks and that is a wicket for Abbott as well in his first over. Replays show the two noises were off the ball hitting both the pads. Had Burns reviewed it would have stayed with the on-field call since the Ball Tracker shows it was clipping leg stump.
Full outside off, swinging away, Burns is not lured into it.
Angled on a fuller length outside off, Burns comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Nice! On a length on off, Burns is opened up a touch but he does well to keep it out.
Outside off, left alone by Burns.
Starts with a full toss on middle, Burns just about clips it towards mid-wicket.
KYLE ABBOTT to bowl from the other end. He too has three slips and a gully for him.
USMAN KHAWAJA comes out to bat at number 3.

OUT! POOR SHOT! Sprays it wide outside off, Warner wants to reach out and drive it through but is in no position at all. He only manages to edge it through and de Kock goes to his left to take a safe catch. What a start for South Africa, a wicket right in the first over and that too a big one. It is how he plays but one wonders if you need to respect the conditions a bit more.
Another one down the leg side, Warner again goes after it but fails to connect. de Kock has to dive again to stop that one.
Bowls it way down the leg side, de Kock does well to dive to his right and stop that one.
Vernon sprays sawdust on the landing area.
Good length on middle, Burns clips it towards square leg for a single. He too is off the mark.
Fuller outside off, swings away a touch, Joe Burns lets it go through.
Off the mark! Starts on a length outside off, Warner comes forward and pushes it to Cook at short extra cover. He misfields and Warner is off the mark with a single.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. The two Australian openers are David Warner and Joe Burns. South Africa begin with Vernon Philander! Three slips and a gully for him. Here we go...

TOSS - South Africa have won a vital toss and will be bowling first. One forced  change for them - Kyle Abbott comes in for Dale Steyn. Joe Mennie and Callum Ferguson were handed their baggy greens earlier today. They have replaced Peter Siddle and Mitchell Marsh. Joe Burns comes in for the injured Shaun Marsh.

Weather could be the only worry since showers have been forecast right throughout the Test. South Africa will want to seal the series in the second Test itself after putting a superb performance in the first game. It was the youngster Kagiso Rabada who led them brilliantly. They haven't played a Test without Dale Steyn and AB de Villiers for a long time but they won one without them, can they do it again? Let's see.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the second Test between Australia and South Africa at Hobart. The hosts are trailing the series after being hammered in the first Test at Perth. There are a few injury concerns and with new enforcement coming in, Australia will hope the team can show resilience and stage a comeback in the series. Steven Smith and co. will be under pressure to perform and with a lively pitch on hand, things could get really interesting.
